exposure: Women with unverified penicillin allergy and GBS
Women with unverified penicillin allergy without GBS
cohort: 170,379 pregnant women who delivered live infants at Kaiser Permanente Southern California between January 1, 2009, and December 31, 2014
finding: Unverified penicillin allergy in pregnant women is associated with increased cesarean section rates, longer hospital stays, and higher rates of antibiotic-associated adverse drug reactions, particularly among GBS-positive women.
mod_finding: Women with a penicillin allergy, with or without GBS, had significantly (about 10%) higher cesarean section rates.
